acceptance.criterion: Only a fixture started and held in live memory can be passed to Windows taskkill /T; no public --pid and no process-name match.
The fixture records live parent/descendant/sentinel before stop, only verifies success after parent exit and descendant absence while unrelated sentinel stays live.
A positive fixture receipt never reports production UAT PID safety, browser UAT, independent verification or merge eligibility.
Synthetic CI can be green, but Windows native start-stop tree proof must be executed by the owner on actual Windows before this Issue's operational acceptance.

constraints: No production changes to scripts/windows-uat-control.mjs; keep native stop as isolated proof fixture only.
Never target an external PID, unmatched stale PID, Windows service, or arbitrary process.
No user credentials, auth sessions, model dispatch, browser UAT or project assets are accessed.
Initial observed-fail, observed-pass and started-uncertain original private scopes remain preserved.
Linux CI green alone cannot claim Windows process-tree STOP proven; independently run once on the operator's Windows machine.
